summary: This directory centralizes internal helper utilities for resolving filesystem paths and naming conventions specific to documentation artifacts. It ensures consistent path generation and localization logic for readme-related files throughout the project.
responsibilities: Determine base paths for knowledge artifacts
relationships: Configuration context is used to determine the appropriate file system paths for knowledge artifacts.
Localization parameters dictate the generation of specific readme filenames.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of internal path resolution logic
Centralization of naming conventions for documentation
